author: vla89bs
quote:
I payed 80 euro for what I thought was Grand Theft Auto, but what i got was a photorealistic relationship simulator.

I wanted freedom and chaos and the funny and unrestricted enjoyable sandbox gameplay GTA is legendary know for. Not a boyfriend simulator where my sidequests are about buying groceries, fixing the stairs or "making my girlfriend happy" some other way, what the actual F.

Beautiful graphics cannot compensate for lackluster gameplay and sad, woke, feminist slop this game is. €80 spent, and I genuinely regret buying it and worse: i played just a bit over 2 hours before I gave up only to find out I cannot get a refund. I'll never buy a SLOPSTAR game again.
